item.tib: dbal phur yang snying rgyud las 'phrin las brnag pa'i byang bu
item.coloph: dbal phur yang snying 'phrin las brnag pa'i byang bu/ rma rgyal pom ra'i thugs ka nas kho bo dbra khyung pa stag la'i thugs sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gsang mtshan dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag gis thon pa lags so/ ma tshang kha bskang du brnag pa'i las kyi byang bu sgron ma nas bkol ba gdan sa khyung nag pho brang du dge'o/ bka' gter gnyis bsdoms pa'i byin rlabs shin tu che'o//
